tracking.notes: Multi-channel strobe illumination configuration for DRI1000 optical station.
tracking.additionalInstruction: Verify total strobe thermal dissipation does not exceed 45W continuous equivalent.

safetyInterlocks.notes: Optical enclosure verified light-tight; personnel safe from high-intensity pulsed strobe flashes.
safetyInterlocks.additionalInstruction: Do not energize ultraviolet or overdrive channels if enclosure safety switch reports open.

attributes.notes: Programs Gardasoft CC320 4-channel controller for dual-channel overdrive darkfield and coaxial flash.
attributes.additionalInstruction: Ensure pulse width does not exceed 500 microseconds under 300% overdrive.

executionPolicy.notes: Transmits current profiles and pulse widths directly to controller internal EEPROM/RAM registers.
executionPolicy.additionalInstruction: If controller reports channel over-current warning, fall back to safe continuous mode.

channels.name: CoaxialTopWhite
channels.notes: Coaxial on-axis brightfield illumination for surface markings and lead coplanarity.

channels.name: RingDarkfield45Deg
channels.notes: Oblique darkfield ring illumination to emphasize white box perimeter and edge relief.

channels.name: BacklightDiffuse
channels.notes: Diffuse silhouette backlight for dimensional contour inspection (disabled for surface marking).

channels.name: AngleZoneAuxiliary
channels.notes: Fluorescent UV quadrant lighting reserved for conformal coating inspection.

actions.notes: Arms channels 1 and 2 with synchronized 500us pulses triggered by Opto Input 1.
actions.additionalInstruction: Verify LED current loop feedback before asserting strobe ready bit.

handshake.notes: Strobe controller replies with channel resistance and programmed voltage status.
handshake.additionalInstruction: Abort sequence if controller reports open circuit on enabled channels.
